result.title: PFedHASNet: A Personalized Federated Hybrid Analog-Spike Network for Multi-Subject Motor Imagery EEG Decoding
result.comment: 13 pages, 7 figures. Submitted to IEEE Journal of Biomedical and Health Informatics
result.summary: Motor imagery electroencephalography (MI-EEG) data are often collected and stored separately across subjects or institutions, and EEG acquisition and annotation remain costly. Training models solely on individual subject data limits the use of information from other subjects, whereas centralizing raw EEG recordings raises privacy and data governance concerns. Federated learning (FL) enables collaborative model training across distributed clients without sharing raw EEG data, providing a practical approach to leveraging information from multiple subjects. Accordingly, we propose PFedHASNet, a personalized federated hybrid analog-spike network for MI-EEG decoding. The shared encoder integrates continuous-valued temporal features, leaky integrate-and-fire (LIF) spike responses, and channel-wise log-variance statistics through learnable fusion weights. Client-private residual adapters and classifiers perform subject-specific feature refinement and personalized prediction, respectively. Experiments on held-out trials from participating subjects across four public MI-EEG datasets show that PFedHASNet achieves the highest mean client macro-F1 among 18 model configurations in cross-model comparisons, while maintaining competitive decoding performance with a compact client-side model in comparisons using the same backbone. Ablation studies further examine the contributions of hybrid representations and personalization components to decoding performance.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 PFedHASNet，将连续时序特征、LIF 脉冲响应与通道 log-variance 统计以可学习权重融合，并在联邦框架下用客户端私有残差适配器和分类器实现个体化运动想象 EEG 解码。
AI.relevance_reason: 研究问题为跨被试 EEG 解码与联邦隐私训练，混合表示仅是编码器侧特征拼接，未涉及 latent 推理状态、视觉证据使用或停止/计算分配，缺乏可供核查的 LVR 借鉴线索。
